title: Webhook Echo
content:
Handling webhooks securely is complex. You need to verify signatures, handle retries, and parse payloads. Echo solves this by providing a standardized receiver for providers like Stripe, GitHub, and custom HMAC sources.

Installation

bun add @gravito/echo

Stripe Example

Echo provides a pre-built driver for Stripe that handles signature verification automatically.

import { WebhookReceiver } from '@gravito/echo'

const receiver = new WebhookReceiver()
receiver.registerProvider('stripe', process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET!)

app.post('/webhooks/stripe', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.text()
  const headers = c.req.header()
  
  // Verify signature
  const result = await receiver.verify('stripe', body, headers)
  
  if (!result.valid) {
     return c.json({ error: 'Invalid Signature' }, 400)
  }
  
  if (result.eventType === 'payment_intent.succeeded') {
    // Handle payment
  }
  
  return c.json({ received: true })
})
